Lord '''Malichose''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] who lived during the time of the [[Great Galactic War]]. A fluent speaker of the old [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Sith (language)|tongue]], Malichose had achieved the rank of Sith Lord by [[3678 BBY]]. After the Imperial victory at the [[Invasion of Begeren]], Malichose read ancient Sith poems in the old tongue to the people of [[Kaas City]] as part of the widespread celebrations.<ref name="BotE">''[[The Old Republic, Blood of the Empire Act 1: Shades of the Sith]]''</ref> [[3640 BBY|Thirty-eight]] years later, Malichose served in the [[Battle of Corellia]] at [[Darth Decimus]]' personal request.<ref name="Coronet Arms">{{TORcite|type=faction|Empire|Coronet Arms Massacre|Corellia}}</ref> He had also seen action during the [[Alderaan Civil War]] earlier, on a mission to gain access to hidden vaults on [[Elysium]].<ref name="TOR" />
